The third-year kicker has actually been quite good overall this season, making 24-of-28 field-goal attempts and 19-of-20 PATs through 11 games.

news.analysis: Knight tied Tyler Alleiger for the same number of carries, but outgained him on the ground. His seven rushing attempts are the most in a game for Knight since he saw 15 carries against the Rams in Week 6. Knight and the Cardinals will take on the Commanders in Week 12.

news.contents: Arizona Cardinals running back Bam Knight had a quiet game in his team's 34-7 Week 11 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs, recording just 45 yards from scrimmage on eight touches. While Knight continues to see a significant role in the Cardinals' offense with running back Jeremiyah Love (ankle) on Injured Reserve, he's still splitting touches with fellow Arizona back Tyler Allgeier. Given the Cardinals' current offensive struggles, there just hasn't been enough opportunity for one back to produce ...

news.contents: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye (leg) could be sidelined until late in the regular season, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Maye fractured his right fibula on the opening drive of New England's Week 10 loss to the Detroit Lions in Munich. ESPN reported that Maye is expected to avoid surgery and that tests showed no additional ligament damage. The Patriots are on their Week 11 bye and still list Maye on the active roster. news.contents: Carolina Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) will miss Sunday's Week 11 home game against the Baltimore Ravens after Carolina downgraded him from questionable to out Saturday, as ESPN's Adam Schefter reported. Carolina kept Brooks on injured reserve after he practiced in full Friday for the third straight day. He had been limited in Thursday and Friday practices before Week 10. He aggravated the groin injury against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 2 and returned to practice on Nov. 11. ...
